# Prestruct - AI Context

## What is Prestruct?
Prestruct is a build-time SEO prerendering tool for Vite + React apps deployed on Cloudflare Pages. It generates static HTML per route with correct SEO metadata, schema.org markup, and cache headers without runtime infrastructure changes.

## Target Audience
Frontend developers and site owners deploying React applications who want reliable SEO and enhanced search visibility without changing their existing stack or infrastructure.

## Key Features
- Static prerendered HTML per route at build time
- Correct SEO meta tags injected (title, description)
- Open Graph and Twitter card metadata
- schema.org JSON-LD structured data
- Automatic sitemap.xml generation
- Immutable asset caching for Cloudflare Pages
- Dynamic islands for client-only content
- Bot proxy for dynamic routes

## Pricing
Open source under MIT license, free to use.
